run_measure_source_contributions: run the script to measure source contributions for machine translation toxicity analysis across languages
run_skip_compilation: run the script with skip compilation flag to analyze pre-compiled source contribution results
run_custom_languages: run the script with custom language codes to analyze specific languages for source contributions
calculate_gini_impurity: calculate the Gini impurity of aligned descriptor word lists to measure translation robustness
review_measure_source_contributions: review the measure_source_contributions function that computes toxicity statistics and correlations across languages
